title: InfoFlow KV: Information-Flow-Aware KV Recomputation for Long Context
authors: Xin Teng; Canyu Zhang; Shaoyi Zheng; Danyang Zhuo; Tianyi Zhou; Shenji Wan
venue_full: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR 306)
affiliations: New York University, New York University Shanghai, Duke University, MBZUAI
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multimodal serving

problem_statement.en: RAG-based long-context question answering is bottlenecked by inference-time prefilling over large retrieved contexts. Precomputing per-document KV caches breaks cross-chunk causal dependencies, and existing selective recomputation methods (CacheBlend, EPIC) select tokens via heuristics or representation discrepancies without modeling whether the selected tokens can actually influence generation.
problem_statement.zh: RAG 長 context 問答的推理瓶頸在於對大量檢索內容的 prefill 計算。預先為個別文件計算 KV cache 會破壞跨 chunk 的因果相依性，而既有的選擇性重算方法（CacheBlend、EPIC）僅依靠啟發式規則或表徵差異挑選 token，未建模所選 token 是否真能影響生成結果。

key_innovation.en: Casts selective KV recomputation as an information-flow problem: a prompt-conditioned attention-norm criterion, computed under an inference-consistent global RoPE reconstruction of retrieved chunks, selects tokens that are both semantically relevant and positionally able to propagate information; an information-flow-guided chunk reordering strategy additionally places informative chunks closer to the prompt.
key_innovation.zh: 將選擇性 KV 重算建模為 information flow 問題：在與推理一致的全域 RoPE 位置重建下，以 prompt 條件化的 attention-norm 準則挑選既語義相關、又在位置結構上能傳遞資訊的 token；並進一步提出 information-flow 導向的 chunk 重排序策略，將資訊量高的 chunk 移近 prompt。

key_improvements.en: Best or second-best accuracy on four LongBench QA benchmarks across Qwen3-14B, Llama-3.1-8B and GLM-4-9B at a fixed 15% recomputation ratio, outperforming CacheBlend and EPIC; with 4-GPU sequence parallelism, up to 3.49x TTFT speedup over single-GPU full prefill and 2.57x over Ring Attention at 32K tokens; consistent gains on Qwen3-VL-8B vision-language benchmarks.
key_improvements.zh: 在固定 15% 重算比例下，於 Qwen3-14B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 GLM-4-9B 的四項 LongBench QA 基準上取得最佳或次佳精度，優於 CacheBlend 與 EPIC；在 4-GPU sequence parallelism 下，32K token 時 TTFT 較單 GPU full prefill 最高加速 3.49x、較 Ring Attention 加速 2.57x；於 Qwen3-VL-8B 視覺語言基準亦有一致增益。

gpu_count: 4x H100 (sequence-parallel efficiency runs); 1x A100 (single-GPU latency runs)
